_comment: Compound annual growth rate (g) per business category, used in the k-big-2 Demand formula D = N*Q*P*(1+g)^t. Update manually on a monthly cadence as better Zambian sector data becomes available. Values are illustrative estimates, not audited figures -- flagged as a methodology assumption in the investor documentation.

_demand_normalization._comment: D = N*Q*P*(1+g)^t is a raw Kwacha-scale number, but the viability formula weights it alongside six 0-10 sub-scores. We log-scale D against `reference_max` (an annual-demand figure considered 'excellent' for a Zambian micro/small business) to produce a comparable 0-10 demand_score: score = min(10, log10(D+1) / log10(reference_max) * 10). This constant is the primary lever for recalibrating demand scoring across the whole dataset.
